caption:
is it flushing or rosacea?

Red that fades is flushing. It comes and goes with heat, wine or exercise. Red in the middle of the face that doesn't settle points toward rosacea.

In a survey of 135 people with rosacea, two in three of those with more than one type said the redness came first. Bumps often came and went, so a photo taken during a flare helps.

Red for over a month with no clear trigger is worth a dermatologist visit.

Send this to the friend who blames every red day on wine.

General education only. Not a diagnosis.

Sources:
Tan et al., Br J Dermatol 2013. doi:10.1111/bjd.12385
van Zuuren et al., Br J Dermatol 2015 (Cochrane review)
